70void ASideScrollingCharacter::SetupPlayerInputComponent(class UInputComponent* PlayerInputComponent)
71{
72 Super::SetupPlayerInputComponent(PlayerInputComponent);
73
74 // Set up action bindings
75 if (UEnhancedInputComponent* EnhancedInputComponent = Cast<UEnhancedInputComponent>(PlayerInputComponent))
76 {
77 // Jumping
78 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(JumpAction, ETriggerEvent::Started, this, &ASideScrollingCharacter::DoJumpStart);
79 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(JumpAction, ETriggerEvent::Completed, this, &ASideScrollingCharacter::DoJumpEnd);
80
81 // Interacting
82 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(InteractAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &ASideScrollingCharacter::DoInteract);
83
84 // Moving
85 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(MoveAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &ASideScrollingCharacter::Move);
86
87 // Dropping from platform
88 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(DropAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &ASideScrollingCharacter::Drop);
89 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(DropAction, ETriggerEvent::Completed, this, &ASideScrollingCharacter::DropReleased);
90
91 }
92}

94void ASideScrollingCharacter::NotifyHit(class UPrimitiveComponent* MyComp, AActor* Other, class UPrimitiveComponent* OtherComp, bool bSelfMoved, FVector HitLocation, FVector HitNormal, FVector NormalImpulse, const FHitResult& Hit)
95{
96 Super::NotifyHit(MyComp, Other, OtherComp, bSelfMoved, HitLocation, HitNormal, NormalImpulse, Hit);
97
98 // only apply push impulse if we're falling
99 if (!GetCharacterMovement()->IsFalling())
100 {
101 return;
102 }
103
104 // ensure the colliding component is valid
105 if (OtherComp)
106 {
107 // ensure the component is movable and simulating physics
108 if (OtherComp->Mobility == EComponentMobility::Movable && OtherComp->IsSimulatingPhysics())
109 {
110 const FVector PushDir = FVector(ActionValueY > 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
111
112 // push the component away
113 OtherComp->AddImpulse(PushDir * JumpPushImpulse, NAME_None, true);
114 }
115 }
116}

156void ASideScrollingCharacter::DoMove(float Forward)
157{
158 // is movement temporarily disabled after wall jumping?
159 if (!bHasWallJumped)
160 {
161 // save the movement values
162 ActionValueY = Forward;
163
164 // figure out the movement direction
165 const FVector MoveDir = FVector(1.0f, Forward > 0.0f ? 0.1f : -0.1f, 0.0f);
166
167 // apply the movement input
168 AddMovementInput(MoveDir, Forward);
169 }
170}

189void ASideScrollingCharacter::DoInteract()
190{
191 // do a sphere trace to look for interactive objects
192 FHitResult OutHit;
193
194 const FVector Start = GetActorLocation();
195 const FVector End = Start + FVector(100.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
196
197 FCollisionShape ColSphere;
198 ColSphere.SetSphere(InteractionRadius);
199
200 FCollisionObjectQueryParams ObjectParams;
201 ObjectParams.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_Pawn);
202 ObjectParams.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_WorldDynamic);
203
204 FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams;
205 QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(this);
206
207 if (GetWorld()->SweepSingleByObjectType(OutHit, Start, End, FQuat::Identity, ObjectParams, ColSphere, QueryParams))
208 {
209 // have we hit an interactable?
210 if (ISideScrollingInteractable* Interactable = Cast<ISideScrollingInteractable>(OutHit.GetActor()))
211 {
212 // interact
213 Interactable->Interaction(this);
214 }
215 }
216}

218void ASideScrollingCharacter::MultiJump()
219{
220 // does the user want to drop to a lower platform?
221 if (DropValue > 0.0f)
222 {
223 CheckForSoftCollision();
224 return;
225 }
226
227 // reset the drop value
228 DropValue = 0.0f;
229
230 // if we're grounded, disregard advanced jump logic
231 if (!GetCharacterMovement()->IsFalling())
232 {
233 Jump();
234 return;
235 }
236
237 // if we have a horizontal input, try for wall jump first
238 if (!bHasWallJumped && !FMath::IsNearlyZero(ActionValueY))
239 {
240 // trace ahead of the character for walls
241 FHitResult OutHit;
242
243 const FVector Start = GetActorLocation();
244 const FVector End = Start + (FVector(ActionValueY > 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f) * WallJumpTraceDistance);
245
246 FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams;
247 QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(this);
248
249 GetWorld()->LineTraceSingleByChannel(OutHit, Start, End, ECC_Visibility, QueryParams);
250
251 if (OutHit.bBlockingHit)
252 {
253 // rotate to the bounce direction
254 const FRotator BounceRot = UKismetMathLibrary::MakeRotFromX(OutHit.ImpactNormal);
255 SetActorRotation(FRotator(0.0f, BounceRot.Yaw, 0.0f));
256
257 // calculate the impulse vector
258 FVector WallJumpImpulse = OutHit.ImpactNormal * WallJumpHorizontalImpulse;
259 WallJumpImpulse.Z = GetCharacterMovement()->JumpZVelocity * WallJumpVerticalMultiplier;
260
261 // launch the character away from the wall
262 LaunchCharacter(WallJumpImpulse, true, true);
263
264 // enable wall jump lockout for a bit
265 bHasWallJumped = true;
266
267 // schedule wall jump lockout reset
268 GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(WallJumpTimer, this, &ASideScrollingCharacter::ResetWallJump, DelayBetweenWallJumps, false);
269
270 return;
271 }
272 }
273
274
275
276 // test for double jump only if we haven't already tested for wall jump
277 if (!bHasWallJumped)
278 {
279 // are we still within coyote time frames?
280 if (GetWorld()->GetTimeSeconds() - LastFallTime < MaxCoyoteTime)
281 {
282 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("Coyote Jump"));
283
284 // use the built-in CMC functionality to do the jump
285 Jump();
286
287 // no coyote time jump
288 } else {
289
290 // The movement component handles double jump but we still need to manage the flag for animation
291 if (!bHasDoubleJumped)
292 {
293 // raise the double jump flag
294 bHasDoubleJumped = true;
295
296 // let the CMC handle jump
297 Jump();
298 }
299 }
300 }
301}

303void ASideScrollingCharacter::CheckForSoftCollision()
304{
305 // reset the drop value
306 DropValue = 0.0f;
307
308 // trace down
309 FHitResult OutHit;
310
311 const FVector Start = GetActorLocation();
312 const FVector End = Start + (FVector::DownVector * SoftCollisionTraceDistance);
313
314 FCollisionObjectQueryParams ObjectParams;
315 ObjectParams.AddObjectTypesToQuery(SoftCollisionObjectType);
316
317 FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams;
318 QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(this);
319
320 GetWorld()->LineTraceSingleByObjectType(OutHit, Start, End, ObjectParams, QueryParams);
321
322 // did we hit a soft floor?
323 if (OutHit.GetActor())
324 {
325 // drop through the floor
326 SetSoftCollision(true);
327 }
328}
